title: Wings visit the Grand Ole Opry, Nashville | 1974
content:
Wings paid a visit to the Grand Ole Opry House in Nashville, Tennessee, on 28 June 1974 .

This was their second visit to the venue, having attended a show on 16 June.

On this evening they also attended a cocktail party before the show in the VIP lounge. The actual show at the Grand Ole Opry was broadcast live on Nashville radio.

The McCartneys watched the show backstage. The performers included the Cates Sisters, Marcy and Margie, who were subsequently booked to perform at a Wings/Linda McCartney session on 8 July.
